inquiries.name: kevin marshall
inquiries.message: hi — i run a small graphic design studio and we need about 1,000-1,200 sq ft with office space up front. is the office area finished with drywall and flooring? also, is the internet hookup ready or would we need to arrange that ourselves?

inquiries.name: patricia gomez
inquiries.message: we make handmade candles and need a space for production and shipping. does this unit have ventilation good enough for light manufacturing with wax? we'd also like to tour sometime this week if possible.

inquiries.name: devon parks
inquiries.message: i'm a commercial photographer looking for studio space. how much natural light does this unit get? also, is the ceiling height consistent throughout, or is part of it lower due to ductwork?

inquiries.name: alex rivera
inquiries.message: we're a plumbing contractor and need a bay to store our vans and equipment. is the roll-up door wide enough for a full-size work van? and is there 24/7 access or set business hours?

inquiries.name: tamika jones
inquiries.message: we're expanding our small freight operation and need warehouse space near the port. can you tell me the truck court depth and whether 53-ft trailers can maneuver in and out without issues?
